newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends sharply up on heavy dlr sales.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends sharply up on heavy dlr sales.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed sharply higher on Wednesday on heavy speculator dollar sales, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.28 to the dollar, after opening at 57.63. The rupee closed at 57.55 on Tuesday.
"Sepculators used today's overseas decline of the dollar to bring down the currency, so that they could buy back at lower levels," said a dealer at Commercial Bank.
No import covering was seen on Wednesday to provide a safety net for the dollar, he said.
"Speculators also believe the upside of the exchange rate is capped at the psychological level of 58 rupees, even if the dollar gains again overseas," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
Overnight call money rates closed at 14 percent, after moving in a tight range of 14 to 15 prcent, dealers said.
